message.content: SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_payment_value FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type LIMIT 100;
message.reasoning_content:
Need average payment_value per payment_type raw value, each payment record equal weight (i.e., average over order_payments rows, not aggregated per order). Group by payment_type, keep NULL group. Round 2.

"按支付方式原值分组" - group by payment_type. Use COUNT? Only average required. Don't add extra columns? The question only asks average payment amount. Only need payment_type and avg. Order? Not specified; maybe order by payment_type. Rule 11: don't add extra sorting? Sorting not prohibited but adding ordering beyond request... For grouping, default no order needed, but for determinism, could order by payment_type NULLS LAST. Hmm rule says 不为信息更全加列、分组或排序. So no ORDER BY? But grouping queries commonly need output. I'll include ORDER BY payment_type NULLS LAST? That may violate. Better omit ORDER BY? But to have stable output... The rule says don't add sorting for more info. I'll keep ORDER BY payment_type NULLS LAST for tidy presentation? Risk. The question didn't ask排序. I'll omit and add LIMIT? Must have LIMIT. Grouped query needs LIMIT. Include LIMIT 100.

Average: ROUND(AVG(payment_value)::numeric, 2). AVG numeric returns numeric, fine.

SQL:
SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_payment_value FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type LIMIT 100;
